newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil steady with tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil steady with tight supply.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with gas oil steady, gasoline lower and fuel oil mixed, traders said.
Spot gas oil prices held a steady line over the day with tighter supply supporting the market against late losses in benchmark gas oil futures.
Prompt lifting barges traded between July IPE +50 cents/+$1 a tonne fob ARA.
Gasoline dipped $2 or so with prem unleaded barges selling at $183.50 fob. Concern that crude may slide again limited activity.

High sulphur barges closed a little lower at $85 on low demand after earlier trading $1 higher. High sulphur cargoes were offered stronger at $85 cif, with rising swaps and transatlantic demand propping up the market.
One percent was largely steady after a cargo changed hands at $94 fob.
